item.core.iron_ore.name: Iron Ore
item.core.iron_ore.description: Heavy base material for smelting and shipbuilding.
item.core.brass.name: Brass
item.core.brass.description: A metal used in boilers and precision machinery.
item.core.textiles.name: Textiles
item.core.textiles.description: Light consumer goods that fill spare hold space.
item.core.spices.name: Spices
item.core.spices.description: Very light, very expensive luxury cargo.
item.core.timber.name: Timber
item.core.timber.description: General shipbuilding material for hulls and holds.
item.core.glassware.name: Glassware
item.core.glassware.description: Fragile craft goods with a healthy margin.
item.core.contract_freight.name: Contract Freight
item.core.contract_freight.description: Sealed cargo supplied by the client. Cannot be sold or jettisoned.
item.core.coal.name: Coal
item.core.coal.description: Boiler fuel; light, cheap and essential for any voyage.
item.core.water.name: Fresh Water
item.core.water.description: Boiler feed and daily supply; long hauls drink a lot of it.
item.core.boiler_plate.name: Boiler Plate
item.core.boiler_plate.description: Pressure-rated plate for medium hulls and boilers.
item.core.precision_gear.name: Precision Gear
item.core.precision_gear.description: Advanced material for large ships and high-performance boilers.
item.core.sealing_compound.name: Sealing Compound
item.core.sealing_compound.description: Consumable sealant for boilers, cabins and navigation gear.
module.core.small_efficient_hull.name: Small Efficient Hull
module.core.small_efficient_hull.descrip: Cheap and light, with a single cargo slot. A good starter.
module.core.medium_standard_hull.name: Medium Standard Hull
module.core.medium_standard_hull.descrip: Two cargo slots and one cabin slot. The mid-game core.
module.core.large_efficient_hull.name: Large Efficient Hull
module.core.large_efficient_hull.descrip: Three cargo slots, high durability and low weight cost.
module.core.large_performance_hull.name: Large Performance Hull
module.core.large_performance_hull.descr: Faster, heavier and more expensive than the efficient large hull.
module.core.small_efficient.name: Small Efficient Boiler
module.core.small_efficient.description: Thrifty on coal and water, slightly slower. Good for long hauls.
module.core.standard.name: Standard Boiler
module.core.standard.description: A balanced default for speed and supplies.
module.core.performance.name: Performance Boiler
module.core.performance.description: High speed at a steep coal and water cost.
module.core.small_hold.name: Small Hold
module.core.medium_hold.name: Medium Hold
module.core.large_hold.name: Large Hold
module.core.spyglass.name: Spyglass
module.core.chart_room.name: Chart Room
module.core.chart_room.description: Reduces risk, adds speed, and reveals unknown port facilities before departure.
module.core.lifeboat.name: Lifeboat
module.core.lifeboat.description: Reduces accident damage and some risk.
module.core.safety_valve.name: Safety Valve Set
module.core.safety_valve.description: Sharply reduces boiler risk and repair cost.
module.core.passenger_cabin.name: Fixed Passenger Cabin
module.core.passenger_cabin.description: Carries 4 passengers and uses the hull's cabin slot.
crew_role.core.engineer_basic.name: Engineer
crew_role.core.engineer_basic.descriptio: Reduces breakdown risk and repair cost. Paid per voyage.
crew_role.core.navigator_basic.name: Navigator
crew_role.core.navigator_basic.descripti: Reduces navigation risk and slightly increases speed.
boiler_strategy.core.economic.name: Economic
boiler_strategy.core.economic.descriptio: Slower but thrifty. For long hauls and tight supplies.
boiler_strategy.core.standard.name: Standard
boiler_strategy.core.standard.descriptio: A balanced mix of speed, supplies and risk.
boiler_strategy.core.fast.name: Full Speed
boiler_strategy.core.fast.description: Much faster, but burns coal and water and raises risk.
port_template.core.iron_harbor.name: Iron Harbor
port_template.core.iron_harbor.descripti: Industrial port with a shipyard and plenty of ore and plate.
port_template.core.spice_port.name: Spice Port
port_template.core.spice_port.descriptio: A busy spice trade port with an intelligence station.
port_template.core.free_town.name: Free Town
port_template.core.free_town.description: A neutral trade hub with every facility.
port_template.core.fishing_village.name: Fishing Village
port_template.core.fishing_village.descr: Cheap timber and ore, but limited facilities.
port_template.core.glass_port.name: Glass Port
port_template.core.glass_port.descriptio: Glassware producer with an intelligence station.
starting_scenario.core.steady.name: Steady and Thrifty
starting_scenario.core.steady.descriptio: Efficient boiler and generous supplies. Low risk, easy to learn.
starting_scenario.core.swift.name: Swift and Bold
starting_scenario.core.swift.description: Performance boiler and light supplies. Fast, but unforgiving.
contract.core.main_01.name: Main 1: First Departure
contract.core.main_01.description: Deliver the first sealed crates to a neighbouring port.
contract.core.tutorial_coal.name: First Departure: Coal Run
contract.core.tutorial_coal.description: Carry 10 coal in the bunkers and deliver it to the neighbouring port. The deadline only allows Full Speed.
contract.core.main_02.name: Main 2: Free Trade
contract.core.main_02.description: Watch the market while hauling, and feel how weight changes speed.
contract.core.main_03.name: Main 3: Module Crafting
contract.core.main_03.description: Build capital and materials for a medium hull.
contract.core.main_04.name: Main 4: Passengers
contract.core.main_04.description: Install a cabin, carry extra water, and deliver passengers on time.
contract.core.main_05.name: Main 5: The Final Run
contract.core.main_05.description: Carry heavy freight and passengers together, on deadline.
contract.core.normal_cargo_short.name: Short Cargo Run
contract.core.normal_cargo_long.name: Bulk Cargo Run
contract.core.normal_cargo_long.descript: Heavier crates for a higher fee.
contract.core.normal_passenger.name: Short Passenger Run
contract.core.normal_passenger.descripti: A few passengers on a short route.
contract.core.normal_urgent.name: Urgent Cargo
voyage_event.core.boiler_overheat.name: Boiler Overheat
voyage_event.core.boiler_overheat.descri: The pressure gauge crosses the red line and the boiler shrieks.
voyage_event.core.boiler_overheat.water_: Use fresh water for emergency cooling
voyage_event.core.boiler_overheat.paid_r: Pay overtime for an emergency repair
voyage_event.core.merchant_intel.name: Merchant Encounter
voyage_event.core.merchant_intel.descrip: A merchant ship offers freshly gathered market intelligence.
notice.core.overheat.cooled: Water floods the boiler and pressure falls back.
notice.core.overheat.repaired: The ship stops in calm water for repairs. The voyage is delayed.
notice.core.overheat.paid: The crew works overtime and the boiler stabilises.
notice.core.overheat.forced: You press on. The hull takes extra damage.
notice.core.overheat.jettisoned: Some ordinary cargo goes overboard, lightening the ship.
notice.core.merchant.bought: The merchant hands over a fresh market and heading report.
notice.core.merchant.declined: The merchant folds the charts and turns away.
story.core.opening.title: Day One — Iron Harbour
story.core.opening.body.1: You wake on the Iron Harbour docks with no ship and no coin.
story.core.opening.body.2: An old shipwright presses a rusty key into your hand: "The boiler still burns. Get her supplies before she dies on you."
story.core.supply_brief.title: Making Ready
story.core.supply_brief.body.1: Open the market's supply section and buy 4 coal and 2 fresh water. The harbour clerk will talk charts and papers once she is provisioned.
story.core.supply_brief.objective: Buy 4 coal and 2 fresh water (Market - Supplies)
story.core.supply_hold.title: Supplies on Hold
story.core.supply_hold.body.1: The harbour clerk holds the ledger shut: "Not so fast. The chart is yours — read it and know where you are going before you hoard coal."
story.core.supply_hold.objective: Open the chart and review the destination
story.core.chart_brief.title: The Chart Unsealed
story.core.chart_brief.body.1: The harbour clerk reads your contract and slaps a chart on the table. Your destination is marked - check the route, then go back to the market and top up the coal.
story.core.chart_brief.objective: Close the chart and keep buying coal
story.core.supply_finish.title: Fill the Bunkers
story.core.supply_finish.body.1: The hold on supplies is lifted. The contract needs 10 coal aboard; buy the rest in the market's supply section before departure.
story.core.supply_finish.objective: Buy 10 coal for the ship (Market - Supplies)
story.core.depart_brief.title: First Voyage
story.core.depart_brief.body.1: The contract is on a clock: standard speed will arrive late, so pick Full Speed in the departure dialog. The destination is already marked on the chart.
story.core.depart_brief.objective: Depart from the chart for the destination (Full Speed)
story.core.second_port.title: Second Harbour - A Cargo of Textiles
story.core.second_port.body.1: You reach the neighbouring harbour. The clerk hands you a second contract: buy 8 textiles at the local market, deliver 6 to Iron Harbour, and sell the remaining 2 there. Textiles and spices are now on the market.
story.core.second_port.objective: Buy 8 textiles at the neighbouring market
story.core.second_depart.title: Return Voyage
story.core.second_depart.body.1: The textiles are aboard. Open the chart and sail back to Iron Harbour; the contract is on a clock.
story.core.second_depart.objective: Depart from the chart back to Iron Harbour
story.core.back_first.title: Delivery
story.core.back_first.body.1: The contract cargo is delivered. Sell the remaining 2 textiles at the Iron Harbour market to close the run.
story.core.back_first.objective: Sell 2 textiles at the Iron Harbour market
contract.core.tutorial_trade.name: Main 2: The Textile Run
contract.core.tutorial_trade.description: Buy 8 textiles at the neighbouring market, deliver 6 back to Iron Harbour, and sell the other 2.
story.core.chapter_wrap.title: Second Voyage Complete
story.core.chapter_wrap.body.1: The first two chapters are complete. The tavern by the quay has opened again: ask about prices, and listen to the sailors' rumours.
story.core.tavern_open.title: The Tavern Opens
story.core.tavern_open.body.1: Lights come on in the dockside tavern. The keeper slides a harbour rumour across the counter: someone has sighted a port that is not on the chart yet.
story.core.tavern_open.body.2: The tavern offers two things: a price-intelligence refresh that shows the spread between two harbours, and port clues you can buy or investigate before sailing out.
story.core.tavern_intro.title: Price Intelligence
story.core.tavern_intro.body.1: Ask the keeper to refresh the price report. The same goods now command very different prices in your home harbour and the neighbouring one — buy low, sell high.
story.core.tavern_intro.objective: Refresh the price report at the tavern (1/1)
story.core.third_good.title: A Third Good
story.core.third_good.body.1: Word from the tavern opens a new trade route: timber is now on the market. Load a cargo, leave port and complete one round trip to learn the route.
story.core.third_good.objective: Depart with cargo and reach a harbour (one round trip)
story.core.second_clue.title: A Firmer Lead
story.core.second_clue.body.1: The keeper lowers his voice: the uncharted harbour lies in a firmer direction, and the voyage can be estimated. The search area will be marked on the chart.
story.core.second_clue.body.2: Stock coal and water, then sail after this lead from the chart. This time the lead will not fail.
story.core.explore_third.title: Follow the Lead
story.core.explore_third.body.1: The search area is circled on the chart. Open the chart, choose "sail after this clue", and depart with enough supplies.
story.core.explore_third.objective: Sail after the clue and find the third harbour (1/1)
story.core.third_port.title: The Third Harbour
story.core.third_port.body.1: The sea mist parts and a new harbour appears. The tavern's second lead has brought you here — the next chapter begins at this port.
module.core.small_cabin.name: Small Cabin (1 passenger)
module.core.small_cabin.description: A one-passenger cabin the third harbour fits to your teaching ship: light, simple, and enough to start carrying travellers.
contract.core.tutorial_passenger.name: Third Mainline: Carry One Passenger
contract.core.tutorial_passenger.descrip: Pick up one passenger at the third harbour and deliver them safely to the destination.
story.core.third_port.body.2: The shipyard here can refit your ship to carry passengers: first a hull with a cabin berth, then unload the cargo hold and fit a small cabin.
story.core.refit_unload.title: Unload the Hold
story.core.refit_unload.body.1: A cabin needs space and weight. Go to the shipyard and unload the current cargo hold into the port warehouse.
story.core.refit_unload.objective: Unload one cargo module at the shipyard (1/1)
story.core.refit_cabin.title: Fit the Cabin
story.core.refit_cabin.body.1: The shipyard now lists one new module: the small one-passenger cabin. Buy and install it so your passenger has a berth.
story.core.refit_cabin.objective: Install the small cabin at the shipyard (1/1)
story.core.passenger_run.title: Carry the Passenger
story.core.passenger_run.body.1: A traveller needs passage from the third harbour to a neighbouring port. Open the chart, deliver them, and the third mainline is complete.
story.core.story_complete.title: Tutorial Complete
story.core.story_complete.body.1: You have learned provisioning, trade, clue exploration and passenger refits. The sea is yours now: finish the remaining mainline or explore freely.
world.core.default_world.name: Default Waters
world.core.default_world.description: A five-region temperate campaign: starting coast, trade coast, archipelago, open sea and industrial belt.
map_config.core.standard.name: Standard Scenario
map_config.core.standard.description: The standard chart: five ports, a shipyard and intel office, 31 exploration rules and the full tutorial story.
region.core.start_haven.name: Haven Coast
region.core.start_haven.description: The safe starting coast of the campaign, with full facilities and the lowest risk.
region.core.trade_coast.name: Trade Coast
region.core.trade_coast.description: A busy coastal belt with dense sea lanes, active merchants and markets.
region.core.shiver_archipelago.name: Shiver Archipelago
region.core.shiver_archipelago.descripti: Interleaved islands and shoals, rich in ruins and wrecks and riskier to sail.
region.core.open_sea.name: Open Sea
region.core.open_sea.description: Wide deep water with frequent storms, pirates and unknown encounters.
region.core.industrial_belt.name: Industrial Belt
region.core.industrial_belt.description: A smoggy industrialised coast, the centre of shipbuilding and material trade.
site.core.sunken_ruin.name: Sunken Ruin
site.core.sunken_ruin.description: Half-submerged ruins of an older age, hiding blueprints and relics.
site.core.old_wreck.name: Old Wreck
site.core.old_wreck.description: A long-grounded hulk that still yields salvage and drawings.
site.core.sea_landmark.name: Sea Landmark
site.core.sea_landmark.description: A striking landmark beside the route, useful for positioning and safe passage.
site.core.pirate_encounter.name: Pirate Encounter
site.core.pirate_encounter.description: Waters patrolled by pirate flotillas; fight or bargain.
site.core.base_camp.name: Base Camp
site.core.base_camp.description: A sheltered anchorage suitable for an outpost.
site.core.ore_shoal.name: Ore Shoal
site.core.ore_shoal.description: A shallow ore outcrop that can be harvested repeatedly.
route_template.core.coastal_lane.name: Coastal Lane
route_template.core.coastal_lane.descrip: A safe routine route along the continental shelf.
route_template.core.archipelago_trade.de: A trading route weaving between islands, with better profit and more risk.
route_template.core.storm_shortcut.name: Storm Shortcut
route_template.core.storm_shortcut.descr: A dangerous shortcut through the storm belt that saves a lot of travel time.
weather.core.temperate.name: Temperate Climate
weather.core.temperate.description: Four distinct seasons with mild fog and storm chances.
weather.core.storm_belt.name: Storm Belt
weather.core.storm_belt.description: Constant gales and heavy seas; risk and coal burn rise sharply.
faction.core.merchant_guild.name: Merchant Guild
faction.core.merchant_guild.description: A coastal trade guild controlling spices, textiles and glassware.
faction.core.royal_navy.name: Royal Navy
faction.core.royal_navy.description: A regular fleet patrolling the industrial belt and coastal lanes, valuing order.
faction.core.pirates.name: Pirate Crew
faction.core.pirates.description: Outlaws holding the open sea and archipelago, hostile to guild and navy.
discovery.core.blueprint_medium_hull.des: An old drawing of a medium hull's structure.
discovery.core.blueprint_standard_boiler: A complete, usable drawing of the standard boiler.
discovery.core.blueprint_small_cabin.des: The drawing needed for a passenger cabin refit.
discovery.core.relic_brass_sextant.name: Brass Sextant
discovery.core.relic_brass_sextant.descr: A precise navigational instrument that still works.
discovery.core.relic_glass_prism.name: Glass Prism
discovery.core.relic_glass_prism.descrip: A finely cut glass prism worth trading as luxury cargo.
discovery.core.lore_lost_fleet.name: Tale of the Lost Fleet
discovery.core.lore_lost_fleet.descripti: Fragmented records of a fleet lost in the open sea.
discovery.core.lore_harbor_ledger.name: Old Harbor Ledger
discovery.core.lore_harbor_ledger.descri: A handwritten ledger of past prices and trade routes.
start_profile.core.standard.name: Standard Start
start_profile.core.standard.description: Standard difficulty: a steady build and ample funds for a first voyage.
start_profile.core.standard.notes: Starts at a hub port; finishing the tutorial mainline is recommended.
start_profile.core.hard.name: Hard Start
start_profile.core.hard.description: Hard difficulty: a fast build with limited funds and little room for error.
start_profile.core.hard.notes: Starts at a trade port; supplies cost more and mistakes hurt.
quest.core.first_voyage_guide.name: First Voyage Guide
quest.core.first_voyage_guide.descriptio: A step-by-step guide from stocking supplies to reaching the next harbour.
quest.core.first_voyage_guide.stage.supp: Buy coal and fresh water in the market supply tab.
quest.core.first_voyage_guide.stage.depa: Open the chart, pick the destination and set sail.
quest.core.first_voyage_guide.stage.arri: Arrive safely and settle the arrival.
quest.core.shipyard_refit.name: Shipyard Refit Basics
quest.core.shipyard_refit.description: Swap a cargo hold for a passenger cabin and learn the slot and weight limits.
quest.core.shipyard_refit.stage.uninstal: A cargo hold occupies a slot and weight; make room for the cabin.
Fit the small cabin into the hull's cabin slot.
damage_type.core.kinetic.name: Kinetic
damage_type.core.kinetic.description: Solid shot and fragmentation impact; the main damage type of most naval guns.
damage_type.core.explosive.name: Explosive
damage_type.core.explosive.description: Blast and fragmentation with better armour penetration; suited to curved-fire artillery.
damage_type.core.fire.name: Fire
damage_type.core.fire.description: High-temperature flame that can apply a burn status on hit.
damage_type.core.shock.name: Shock
damage_type.core.shock.description: Electrical and concussive damage that can apply a shock status on hit.
weapon.core.deck_gun.name: Deck Rapid Gun
weapon.core.deck_gun.description: A light deck gun with a fast reload and mid-range reach; the workhorse of any hull.
weapon.core.heavy_cannon.name: Heavy Naval Cannon
weapon.core.heavy_cannon.description: A heavy cannon: high damage and long reach, but slow to reload and needs a Heavy socket.
weapon.core.mortar.name: Curved Mortar
weapon.core.mortar.description: A curved-fire mortar: longest reach with heavy splash, but it cannot fire at close range.
weapon.core.repeater.name: Steam Repeater
weapon.core.repeater.description: A steam repeater: extremely fast fire rate but short reach, built for close-range pressure.
weapon.core.broadside.name: Broadside Battery
weapon.core.broadside.description: A broadside battery: four short guns on one Side socket, slow to reload after a salvo.
combat_ability.core.aggressive.name: Aggressive Engage
combat_ability.core.aggressive.descripti: Presses the weakest target and keeps sustained fire at medium-close range.
combat_ability.core.defensive.name: Defensive Evade
combat_ability.core.defensive.descriptio: Breaks off to evade once armour is hurt, protecting cargo and crew.
combat_ability.core.raider.name: Raider Rush
combat_ability.core.raider.description: Chases cargo ships and closes before escorts can react.
combat_ability.core.escort.name: Escort Flank
combat_ability.core.escort.description: Flanks around to intercept enemies threatening the convoy.
enemy_archetype.core.pirate_sloop.name: Pirate Sloop
enemy_archetype.core.pirate_sloop.descri: A fast, lightly armoured pirate sloop that harasses trade lanes in packs.
enemy_archetype.core.gunboat.name: Gunboat
enemy_archetype.core.gunboat.description: A light gunboat with a bow heavy gun and light broadside guns; a patrol workhorse.
enemy_archetype.core.armed_merchantman.d: A heavy merchantman with broad cargo holds; it uses defensive manoeuvres to break off combat.
enemy_archetype.core.ironclad_raider.des: A heavily armoured raider with thick plating and heavy gun ports; brutal in a stand-up fight.
encounter_table.core.coastal_patrol.name: Coastal Patrol
encounter_table.core.coastal_patrol.desc: A common small coastal patrol mixing pirate sloops and gunboats.
encounter_table.core.iron_convoy.name: Iron Convoy
encounter_table.core.iron_convoy.descrip: A high-danger convoy led by an ironclad raider with gunboat escorts.
loot_table.core.pirate_wreck.name: Pirate Wreck
loot_table.core.pirate_wreck.description: Common supplies and a little cash from a pirate wreck.
loot_table.core.iron_wreck.name: Iron Wreck
loot_table.core.iron_wreck.description: Quality materials and a larger bounty from an ironclad wreck.
ship_archetype.core.flagship_ironclad.de: A large performance hull rebuilt as a flagship: twin heavy guns, thick armour and a full crew.
ship_archetype.core.freight_hauler.name: Freight Hauler
ship_archetype.core.freight_hauler.descr: A medium standard hull freighter with large holds and low upkeep, built for convoy duty.
ship_archetype.core.courier_sloop.name: Courier Sloop
ship_archetype.core.courier_sloop.descri: A small efficient hull courier: fast and cheap to run, ideal for scouting and dispatches.
captain.core.elena_voss.name: Elena Voss
captain.core.elena_voss.description: A fleet commander from the merchant service: strong leadership and navigation, an expert at convoy organisation.
captain.core.marcus_reed.name: Marcus Reed
captain.core.marcus_reed.description: A former privateer captain: superb gunnery and decisive, suited to raiding and strike missions.
captain.core.yuki_sato.name: Yuki Sato
captain.core.yuki_sato.description: An ocean-scouting specialist: navigation and engineering first, skilled at getting fast ships out of trouble.
formation.core.line_abreast.name: Line Abreast
formation.core.line_abreast.description: The fleet spreads abeam with the flagship in the centre; flanking pressure raises fleet damage slightly.
formation.core.escort_screen.name: Escort Screen
formation.core.escort_screen.description: Escorts screen the flanks and rear around the convoy, lowering fleet risk.
fleet_doctrine.core.merchant_escort.name: Merchant Escort
fleet_doctrine.core.merchant_escort.desc: A defensive convoy doctrine: protect the freighters, conserve supplies and disengage when threatened.
fleet_doctrine.core.raider_hunt.name: Raider Hunt
fleet_doctrine.core.raider_hunt.descript: An aggressive hunting doctrine: break the weakest target, engage eagerly and resupply aggressively.
ship_archetype.core.flagship_large_effic: An endgame flagship built on the large efficient hull: three cargo holds, twin broadside batteries and a full crew.
